Hi Alicia / Ben — thanks again for the intro call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) Recap from our call:
- Primary use: customer support summarization + routing (~short-context generation + embeddings for retrieval).
- Expected concurrency: low to medium (10-30 concurrent requests).
- Typical request lengths: 150-400 tokens in, 100-600 tokens out depending on summary/detail level.

2) Clarify token volumes (please confirm):
- Monthly requests: ~250k-1.2M requests
- Average tokens per request (in+out): you indicated 600-800 tokens (need confirmation).

3) Pricing / budget signals we discussed:
- You mentioned a target cost target in the order of $X-$Y per month (we need a concrete budget range).
- For modeling, we usually compute $/1M tokens and multiply by expected monthly token consumption.

4) Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm the expected monthly token volume range and an approximate target $/1M tokens (eg $150- $500/1M tokens) or monthly budget cap.
- I'll produce a short invoice-style estimate + a cost model spreadsheet showing per-token unit economics and sensitivities across volumes and quantization options.
- If the estimate looks good, we can schedule a short follow-up (30 min) to walk the numbers and procurement steps.

Attachments: none in this message - I'll follow up with a modeled estimate once you confirm volumes/budget.

Thanks Sean - quick answers below to help your model: 

- Monthly active users (initial pilot): 10k users, but only ~3-5% will hit the feature each month. Expect ~300-500k requests/month for pilot.
- Pilot average tokens/request: we think ~700 tokens (300 in, 400 out).
- Longer term (6-12 months): could scale to 2-3M requests/month depending on conversion.
- Procurement/budget: procurement told us the team has a budget band of roughly $15k- $60k/month for inference (flexible based on ROI).
- Target unit economics: leadership prefers to see estimates at $/1M tokens between $200- $350 to be considered.

Hi Alicia / Ben - thanks for the quick clarification - attached are the artifacts we discussed: 

Attachments:
- acme_pricing_estimate_20270417.xlsx (invoice-style estimate, line-itemed by model tier and quantity)
- acme_cost_model_20270417.xlsx (interactive cost model: tokens/month x model tier x quantization x reserved vs on-demand)
- pricing_calculator_v3.xlsx (internal pricing calculator we used for the workbook)

Executive summary (numbers rounded):
- Pilot (500k requests/mo at ~700 tokens/request => 350M tokens/month):
  - Baseline (1.3B equiv, quantized int8): ~$4,200/month (~$12.00 per 1M tokens) - note: this is a very small model; latency favorable but quality lower.
  - Mid (7B equiv, int8): ~$28,000/month (~$80.00 per 1M tokens) - balanced quality/cost.
  - High (70B equiv, mixed-precision): ~$85,000/month (~$243.00 per 1M tokens) - high quality, higher latency and cost.

- At 2M requests/mo (1.4B tokens/month) the unit economics improve slightly with reserved capacity and batching; see cost model for sensitivity tables. Example: 70B with reserved commitment reduces to ~$180/1M tokens at that volume in our model.

Notes and assumptions (short):
- Token math uses 700 tokens per request (in+out) as you confirmed.
- Pricing lines include inference compute and a small storage/network premium; excludes enterprise add-ons (SLA, dedicated private deploy) which can be quoted separately.
- Reserved capacity discounts assumed at 3-12 month commitment tiers; numbers in the workbook show monthly equivalent.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm which model tier you want priced for an official quote (we can lock in a 30-day estimate)?
- If procurement needs an invoice, I can generate a formal sales invoice & SOW and start the procurement paperwork.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min walk-through of the workbook tomorrow or early next week.

If you want me to flatten this into a single-page invoice only (no workbook), say the word and I'll send over a PDF.
